description: Go SDK for Avalanche wallets, P-Chain and EVM operations; in maintenance mode since December 2025, with community-led issue support.
It is a dedicated library for creating, managing, and authenticating decentralized non-custodial wallets specifically on the Avalanche network
It is the classic Avalanche Platform JavaScript library for interfacing directly with the X-Chain, P-Chain, and C-Chain environments
Local personal-message and EIP-712 typed-data signing and recovery for Avalanche C-Chain applications; callers supply keys and signing domains, and release 9 requires Node.js ^22, ^24 or >=26.
